FAQ

Questions? Answered.

How much do I need to spend on ads?

We recommend a minimum ad spend of $2,000/month to gather meaningful data and see consistent results. Most clients scale to $5,000-15,000/month once the funnel is proven. We never recommend spending more until we have positive ROI data.

What platforms do you run ads on?

We specialize in Facebook/Instagram Ads, Google Ads (Search + Display), and LinkedIn Ads for B2B. We choose platforms based on where your ideal customers actually spend time — not what is trendy.

How long until I see results?

Most campaigns generate leads within the first 7-14 days. However, peak performance typically happens at the 30-60 day mark after we have gathered enough data to optimize audiences, creatives, and landing pages.

Do you guarantee a certain cost per lead?

We cannot guarantee specific CPL numbers — every market is different. What we do guarantee: full transparency on your numbers, weekly optimization, and a clear path to positive ROI. If we cannot make it work, we tell you fast.

What makes your funnels different?

Most agencies build generic landing pages and hope for the best. We build qualification funnels: prospects answer key questions, see relevant case studies, and book directly into your calendar. By the time they reach you, they are pre-sold.
